---
name: Financial report export (Excel/PDF)
description: How ERP report pages export to Excel and PDF, and why the PDF path is HTML-print not a PDF lib.
---

# Report export approach

ERP accounting report pages (trial balance, balance sheet, income statement, cash flow, general ledger) export via a shared client-side helper (`artifacts/erp/src/lib/report-export.ts`) consumed through a reusable `ReportExportButton`. Each page builds a language-agnostic `ReportExport` descriptor (title, company, meta, columns, sections, summary) that both exporters render.

**PDF is generated by opening a window and `window.print()` on built HTML — NOT jspdf/pdfmake.**
**Why:** jspdf/pdfmake cannot shape Arabic glyphs or do RTL without embedding a custom Arabic font; the browser print path delegates font shaping + RTL (`dir="rtl"`) to the browser, so AR renders correctly for free. This matches the pre-existing print pattern in `penalties.tsx` / `receipts.tsx`.
**How to apply:** for any new bilingual (AR/EN) printable/exportable report, reuse the descriptor + HTML-print path; always HTML-escape every interpolated stored field (see print-export-xss memory).

**Excel is SheetJS (`xlsx` 0.18.5, in erp devDeps).**
- RTL sheet: `ws['!views'] = [{ RTL: language === 'ar' }]` (SheetJS does not round-trip this on read, but it is written correctly).
- Money: convert the numeric *string* (e.g. "1234.56") to a Number and set `cell.z = '#,##0.00'` — same numeric value as on-screen numeric(14,2), just thousand-separated for display.

**General ledger gotcha:** the GL endpoint paginates (default pageSize 25, cap 200) with no on-screen pager, so export only ever sees the loaded page. The GL page requests `pageSize: 200` so screen and export stay consistent; ledgers beyond 200 lines still truncate at the API cap.
